title: isocoma acradenia var. bracteosa
intro: Isocoma acradenia var. bracteosa, commonly known as Bracted Isocoma or San Diego Isocoma, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Bracted Isocoma include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
